AN ORDINANCE RELATING TO USE OF WATER FROM CHIPLEY WATERWORKS SYSTEM BY THE COUNTY AND THE STATE HIGHWAY DEPARTMENT, FOR HIGHWAY PURPOSES BY THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT

Be it ordained, by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Chipley, Ga. and it is hereby ordained by the authority of the same, that the Mayor of the Town of Chipley, is hereby authorized and instructed to sign the following agreement with the Board of County Commissioners of Harris County, Ga.

"For and in consideration of the United States Government, through the State Highway Department of Ga. and the County Commissioners of Harris County, having delivered to the Town of Chipley, Nineteen Thousand Feet of Waterworks Pipe, for the nominal charge of twelve cents per foot, to cover cost of delivery, now the Town of Chipley, through its constituted suthorities does hereby agree to furnish to the United States Government, for use of its Troops, Trucks, Tractors, Tanks and other equipment passing through the Town of Chipley, on the Military Highway, ali of the water that may be needed for such use, in the town of Chipley, without any charge whatever.

The Town of Chipley, through its constituted authorities, does further agree to furnish to the County Commissioners of the County of Harris, all of the water from said waterworks system, that may be needed in the construction and maintenance of said Highway, where it is adjoining or within reach of said water Line, and to furnish said service of water, without any charge whstever to said County Commissioners.

Passed in Council for First Reading Monday Dec 20th 1920

2nd Reading adopted

Jan 4 1921
